cells.gaps: No source found says what exceptions the Minister has set to the rule keeping data in the Republic, or that the Commissioner has published a way to send data abroad.
cells.note: The Commissioner said in February 2024 that the Act's implementation began that month, with section 71 setting transfer conditions [ZMB-006]. Section 70(1) keeps processing and storage in the Republic save for exceptions the Minister sets [ZMB-007], so a rule keeping data at home stands beside the transfer rule and the stage is 2.
